description: This file contains the implementation of the ReminderRegistry class within the Orleans runtime, which manages the registration, unregistration, and retrieval of grain reminders in a distributed Orleans application.

classes.name: ReminderRegistry
classes.description: A sealed internal class that manages grain reminders, handling registration, deregistration, and retrieval within the Orleans runtime.

methods.name: RegisterOrUpdateReminder
methods.description: Registers a new reminder or updates an existing one for a specific grain, with validation for input parameters.

methods.name: UnregisterReminder
methods.description: Removes a specified reminder for a grain.

methods.name: GetReminder
methods.description: Retrieves a specific reminder by name for a grain.

methods.name: GetReminders
methods.description: Retrieves all reminders associated with a specific grain.

methods.name: EnsureReminderServiceRegisteredAndInGrainContext
methods.description: Ensures that the reminder service is registered and that the current context is valid for grain operations.

methods.name: ValidateServiceProvider
methods.description: Validates that the service provider is correctly configured with the reminder table service.

methods.name: ThrowInvalidContext
methods.description: Throws an exception if the current execution context is invalid for grain operations.
